Results.ReviewText: Very happy with this grill.  We live in a place that does not allow gas or propane grills.  So this one allows us to grill on the patio and enjoy cooking outdoors.
Results.Title: Love it

Results.ReviewText: It will be great for a picnic table or tailgating use.  Everyday use is limited to the quick draining small LP tanks.  Will need to purchase a converter to use with a standard propane tank.  Grills better than I expected, and the cooking grates are top grade.
Results.Title: LP adapter for a standard tank would be perfect

Results.ReviewText: I love this little grill...I think it works better than the big one I used to have. Weber customer service is awesome to work with
Results.Title: Good Choice

Results.ReviewText: Replaced older Weber Q grill over 15 years old. New one has many improvements such as grates in 2 pieces. The old cart does fit my new one after measuring new one at Ace Hardware. Temp gauge on front is also an asset.
Results.Title: New Q1200 Grill

Results.ReviewText: I bought the Q1200 along with the Weber stand and I absolutely love it. It is perfect for an older family of two and my wife has so far raved about the chicken wings and babyback ribs I have cooked. Clean up is easy and storage? It takes up very little space in my garage.
Results.Title: Q1200 is a retired couple's go-to grill

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill.  Easy to assemble.  Got the cart that goes with it.  Just wish it had a shelf or holder for a larger propane tank.
Results.Title: Perfect size

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill.  Perfect for my husband and me.  Heats quickly, cooks very well.  I can carry it inside my screened porch when it cools off
Results.Title: Perfect grill for a couple

Results.ReviewText: Love this BBQ. Its the perfect size for our family!
Results.Title: Q 1200

ClientResponses.Response: Hi Mike, thank you for sharing your feedback. We are sorry to hear that your grill is not heating evenly and that your grates are sticky. Our Qs are designed to heat evenly with our P shape burner tube! We suggest preheating your grill for 15 minutes with the lid closed as this will help your food not to stick on the grates and even heating. If you continue to experience this issue, please contact us. We will be happy to assist. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Love how light it is for camping compared to our old Q2000.  Heats up evenly across the grates. Cleans up easily.
We got "red" color that everyone enjoyed and caught their eye.

Results.ReviewText: Can get an adaptor to use with your RV propane connection that’s already regulated.
Results.Title: Q use when RV-ing

Results.ReviewText: I don't know why I didn't get one of these earlier! This is a great little grill - easy to use and the right size for one, or a few people. I'm a big fan of Weber's charcoal grills, but cannot have charcoal at my apartment. I love that Weber makes this in several colors and they have stands for the grill that make it easy to move around on my patio as needed.
Results.Title: Great little grill!

Results.ReviewText: Great product I love to cook on the small grill. It is easy to use and easy to clean that is such a big deal to me.  Also enjoy using the app. It is informative.
Results.Title: Newbie Grill cook

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this little grill after having the electric version for several years. I've enjoyed cooking on it - it heats up quickly, the small canisters are easy to hook up, and there is plenty of room for me to cook for 2-4.
Results.Title: Great little grill!

Results.ReviewText: Great grill for camping & RVing! Quality product! Does a great job on steaks & burgers.
Results.Title: Weber Q1200 grill works Great!

Results.ReviewText: Wonderful grill. Easy set up, perfect size for my deck.
Results.Title: Awesome grill!

Results.ReviewText: Great little grill, side wings for staging food or things to add to your stake, cooks very even, lights first time. Glad I spent the money for this portable.
Results.Title: Portable Weber gas grill

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use, great heat output, love the heavy duty gates, and easy to clean up. Love that it folds up compact for tailgating or camping.
Results.Title: great, versatile little grill

Results.ReviewText: Very easy to assemble and use. Great design and very convenient. Works really well and the temperature gauge is a big plus. Cleaning is a bit cumbersome and the plates require extra effort to get clean. Got the adapter for the 20 gallon tank and it works good.
Results.Title: Wener Q series

Results.ReviewText: I have had my Weber Q100 for 10 years now. It has traveled with me to PA, GA, FL, and NY, cooking at home, tailgate events, and even at work. With some general maintenace and care, it has produced countless quality meals. Over the years I have accessorized it with the portable cart, an adapter hose for a 20lb tank, and a cover to protect it from the elements. At this point it's not just a grill, it's gained the respect and sentimental value any long-lived useful tool earns over time. I don't plan on retiring it anytime soon. Thanks, Weber for a quality product.
Results.Title: Withstood the test of time

Results.ReviewText: Light weight, compact and basically fool proof. All the features of the larger Weber grill.
Results.Title: Weber Q 1200 gas grill review

Results.ReviewText: Easy to put together, company is very helpful, I am learning how not to overcook meat.
Results.Title: Very satisfie

Results.ReviewText: This is our second Weber Q 1200.  This wasn’t a replacement but rather an additional one primarily to be used for camping in our motor home.  Great little grill.
Results.Title: Great little grill.

Results.ReviewText: My previous Q1200 is seven years old and still usable, but I was happy to replace it with the same model. I find it meets all my needs, including entertaining for medium sized family gatherings.
Results.Title: David

Results.ReviewText: The best BBQ ever. You won't regret buying this great BBQ
Results.Title: Best grill lines

Results.ReviewText: It is perfect. The food is seared perfectly. The griddle adds so many choices for breakfast grilling. The little gas tanks last longer than I thought too-added bonus.
Results.Title: Perfect little companion

Results.ReviewText: This grill is easy in the sense that it heats up quickly but it has a small grilling space and is very messy to clean after each use.
Results.Title: Easy to use but has limitations

Results.ReviewText: This grill is exactly the right size for my spouse and I to cook up some dinner on the back deck and put the whole thing away in about thirty minutes with no miss or fuss.
